characterList.description: An animated, anthropomorphic pancake with expressive eyebrows and stick-figure limbs.
characterList.name: Pancake

content_metadata.description: The video humorously explores the vastness of the universe, comparing increasingly larger celestial objects.

qAndA.question: What color is the planet KELT-9b in the video?

qAndA.answer: He uses a hamster to represent the Earth and an elephant to represent the Sun.
qAndA.question: What visual metaphor does Pancake use to compare the size of the Earth and the Sun?

qAndA.answer: He believes it helps to remind him that ultimately, nothing that happens to him or the world around him really matters in the grand scheme of everything.
qAndA.question: Why does Pancake think it's helpful to reflect on the size of the universe?

qAndA.answer: UY Scuti is significantly younger than the Sun, estimated to be only 10 to 20 million years old, while the Sun is believed to be 4.6 billion years old.
qAndA.question: What is the approximate age of UY Scuti compared to the Sun?

qAndA.answer: He hopes they have learned something new and had a good time exploring the vastness of the universe with him.
qAndA.question: What does Pancake say he hopes viewers have learned from the video?
